definitions.explanation: A member of the police force responsible for maintaining public order, enforcing laws, and investigating crimes.

examples.japanese: {警察官|けいさつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んで→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{警察官|けいさつかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I got lost, so I asked a police officer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{警察官|けいさつかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He has wanted to become a police officer since he was a child.

examples.japanese: {警察官|けいさつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{交通整理|こうつうせいり}→交通整理：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A police officer is directing traffic at the intersection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{警察官|けいさつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦いたので→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とした→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}た→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧。
examples.english: There were two police officers at the police box in front of the station, so I reported that I had lost my wallet.

notes:
{警察官|けいさつかん} is the formal term for police officer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {警察官|けいさつかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a police officer)
- {警察官|けいさつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call the police)
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧{警察官|けいさつかん} (female police officer)
